description: This Java class defines a command called DeleteThing, which represents an operation to delete a Thing entity within a system. It includes methods for creating instances of the command, parsing it from JSON, and accessing its properties such as the thing ID. The class extends an abstract command and implements interfaces related to Thing modification commands, encapsulating the logic for deletion and serialization details.

classes.name: DeleteThing
classes.description: A command class to delete a specific Thing identified by its ThingId. It facilitates creation from parameters or JSON, serialization, and standard object methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DeleteThing command instance with a specified ThingId and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a DeleteThing command from a JSON string or JSON object, parsing the necessary data.
